What Is a Blister Packaging Tray?

A blister packaging tray is a thermoformed plastic tray with moulded cavities that hold each product firmly in place. The transparent finish lets customers see what they are buying. The rigid structure protects items from dust, moisture, breakage and movement during storage and transport. FAQs

1. What is a blister tray?
A blister tray is a thermoformed plastic tray with moulded cavities that hold products securely. It is used for packing and displaying items like biscuits, cakes, cosmetics and toys while protecting them from damage, dust and moisture.

2. Who is the best blister tray manufacturer in Delhi?
HB Packaging, based in Bawana Industrial Area, Delhi, is a trusted blister tray manufacturer. It supplies custom, high-quality blister packaging trays for food, bakery, cosmetic and retail products.

3. What materials are used to make blister packaging trays?
Blister trays are commonly made from plastics such as PET and PVC. The right material depends on the product, whether it needs food-grade safety, clarity or extra strength.

4. Are blister trays safe for food packaging?
Yes, blister trays made from food-grade material are safe for biscuits, cakes, muffins, sweets and similar items. They keep food hygienic and protected from contamination.

5. Can blister packaging trays be customised?
Yes. Trays can be customised by size, shape, cavity count, depth and thickness to fit your product exactly. HB Packaging manufactures tailor-made trays as per client requirements.

6. How are blister trays manufactured?
They are made by thermoforming. A plastic sheet is heated until soft, shaped over a mould using vacuum or pressure, cooled, and then trimmed into the final tray.

7. What is the difference between a blister tray and a blister pack?
A blister tray is a rigid cavity tray used to hold and display multiple items, mostly in food, bakery and retail packaging. A blister pack is usually a sealed cavity pack, common in pharma and small consumer goods, where a plastic blister is sealed with a backing.

8. Which industries use blister packaging trays?
Food and bakery, confectionery, cosmetics, toys, electronics and general retail packaging use blister trays widely.

9. Are blister trays recyclable?
Many blister trays, especially those made from PET, can be recycled where recycling facilities are available. Ask your manufacturer about recyclable material options.

10. How much does a blister tray cost, and how do I order?
The price depends on size, material, thickness, design complexity and order quantity. For an exact quote, share your product details with HB Packaging by phone or email, and the team will guide you on design, pricing and bulk orders.

FAQs

1. What is blister packaging and what is it used for?
Blister packaging is a type of pre-formed plastic packaging with moulded cavities that hold a product in place, usually with a transparent front so the item is visible. It is used for biscuits, cakes, sweets, cosmetics, toys, electronics and medicines. It protects products from dust, moisture and damage and makes them look better on the shelf.

2. What are the different types of blister packaging?
The main types are blister trays (rigid cavity trays for multiple items), clamshell packs (a hinged, fold-over case), face-seal blisters (a blister sealed onto a card) and full-card blisters (a card that wraps fully around the blister). Blister trays are the most common choice for food, bakery and cosmetic products.

3. Which is better for blister packaging, PET or PVC?
PET is usually preferred because it is clearer, stronger, food-safe and recyclable. PVC is cheaper and easy to thermoform, but it is less eco-friendly. For food and bakery products, PET is generally the safer and more popular choice. The best material depends on your product and budget.

4. What are the advantages and disadvantages of blister packaging?
Advantages: it protects products, gives full visibility, is lightweight, keeps items organised and is cost-effective for bulk orders. Disadvantages: some plastics are not easily recyclable, and a custom design needs an upfront mould. Choosing recyclable materials like PET reduces the environmental concern.

5. What is the difference between blister packaging and clamshell packaging?
Blister packaging holds the product in a moulded cavity, either as an open tray or sealed to a card or lid. A clamshell is a single hinged piece that folds shut around the product. Blister trays suit items that need to sit in fixed positions, such as biscuits or muffins. Clamshells suit single, bulkier items.

6. Is blister packaging safe for food?
Yes, if it is made from food-grade material. Food-grade PET trays are widely used for biscuits, cookies, cakes, muffins, sweets and snacks. Always confirm with your manufacturer that the material is food-grade before packing edible products.

7. Is blister packaging recyclable?
Blister packaging made from a single material like PET is generally recyclable where recycling facilities are available. Packs made from mixed materials, or sealed with different backing materials, are harder to recycle. If sustainability matters to your brand, ask your manufacturer for recyclable PET options.

8. How much does custom blister packaging cost, and is a mould required?
The price per tray depends on size, material, sheet thickness, cavity design and order quantity. Custom trays usually need a mould, which is a one-time tooling cost, and you can reuse the same mould for future orders. Bulk quantities reduce the cost per piece. Share your product size and quantity to get an exact quote.

9. What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for blister trays?
MOQ varies by manufacturer and depends on the design, material and size of the tray. Standard or similar designs may be easier to order in smaller quantities, while fully custom designs often need higher volumes because of the mould and setup. Contact HB Packaging with your requirement to confirm the MOQ for your tray.

10. How do I choose the right blister packaging manufacturer or supplier in India?
Look for a manufacturer with in-house thermoforming and mould capability, food-grade material options, customisation, consistent quality and timely delivery. Ask for samples before bulk orders. Prefer a direct manufacturer-cum-supplier over a trader to get better pricing and quality control. HB Packaging, based in Bawana, Delhi, offers all of this with 10+ years of experience.

11. Who is the best blister packaging manufacturer and supplier in Delhi NCR?
HB Packaging is a trusted blister packaging manufacturer and supplier in Delhi NCR, based in Bawana Industrial Area, Delhi. With 10+ years of experience and 18,000+ projects completed, it offers custom, food-grade and cost-effective blister trays for bakery, food, cosmetic and toy brands. While choosing the best supplier, check for in-house manufacturing, customisation, quality consistency and timely delivery, and ask for samples before placing a bulk order.
